diagnostics.message:
This assignment reads s, so the compiler treats it as an update of s (a relative write, as in the deprecated old SC syntax).
Write it as s *= 10; s += 9 to say so. In one region it means the same.
It only matters when another region also writes s in the same tick: this assignment then runs after that write instead of conflicting with it.
